description: Use when an agent needs an official interest-rate benchmark with its date and source: SOFR (NY Fed), euro short-term rate (ECB, series=estr) or US Treasury par yield curve (series=ust, default 10y). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /rates/reference, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Interest and yield rates only; for euro exchange rates use eu_fx. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: the latest observation on or before this date (default: latest)

series.description: sofr (NY Fed overnight rate), estr (ECB euro short-term rate), ust (US Treasury par yield curve; pick maturity with tenor)

name: rates_reference
title: Rates reference
